integrity: Definitions, proof, and the independently replayable finite test script are provided. The infinite theorem follows from the algebraic and probability arguments; numerical testing alone is not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a one-spike SPD Hessian, one Hessian-applied anisotropic Gaussian sketch, and rank-one Rayleigh spectral correction only.
The 2026 motivating source was available as abstract and introductory preview, not as a fully inspected article; possible specialized coverage in its remaining sections cannot be excluded.
The exact-CG-step comparison is in exact arithmetic for generic independent right-hand sides, not a finite-tolerance cost guarantee.
The stochastic alignment model is not asserted to reproduce the distribution of every ensemble-derived right-hand-side sketch.
title: Sharp Gaussian alignment frontier for one-vector Ritz spectral preconditioning
